name: High School Summer Launch
org: Washington University in St. Louis Pre-College Programs
what_you_do: A summer program with no college credit. It has lectures, workshops and college advice from WashU teachers. You can live on campus or travel in each day.
who_can_apply: You must be in high school now. You can be a freshman, sophomore or junior.
pay_detail: 2026 cost: $985 commuter or $1,485 residential, plus a $50 nonrefundable application fee. Need-based scholarships offered.
duration: Summer program (length not stated on the program page)
deadline_text: 2027 dates and deadline not posted on the program pages.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the program page. Questions: precollege@wustl.edu.
